Overexpression of C2GnT1 resulted in loss of binding of SM3 to MUC1, accompanied by a decrease in the GalNAc/GlcNAc ratio, indicative of a switch to core 2 structures.
Transfection of a C2GnT1 expressing line with ST3Gal-I restored SM3 binding and reduced GlcNAc incorporation into MUC1 O-glycans.
Thus, even when C2GnT1 is expressed, the O-glycans added to MUC1 become core 1-dominated structures, provided expression of ST3Gal-I is increased as it is in breast cancer.
